author: Dr. Sarah Mitchell
role: Emergency Medicine Registrar, Royal Melbourne Hospital
title: Finally, scrubs that fit like high-end designer pieces
content: I've worked 70-hour weeks in hospital scrubs for six years and always hated the boxy potato-sack look. The Women's Tailored Scrub Set in Charcoal is sublime. The drape is so flattering, the fabric breathes during high-stress resus calls, and not a single wrinkle after a 14-hour night shift. The yoga waistband does not slide down when bending over patient beds.

author: Marcus Evans
role: Trauma Resuscitation Nurse, St Vincent's Hospital
title: Athletic shoulder reach and incredible pockets
content: The Men's Athletic Set is genuinely the best scrub set in Australia. Performing CPR compressions or reaching over anaesthetic carts used to rip seams in cheap scrubs. The 4-way BeauTech stretch has no resistance whatsoever. The dedicated shears pocket and phone zip pocket are perfectly positioned.

author: Dr. Anika Patel
title: Stands up to 8-hour theatre procedures with pure comfort
content: Standing in theatre for an 8-hour laparotomy requires fabric that doesn't hold moisture or restrict your shoulder reach. Soft Sage is stunning and calm. Antimicrobial silver really works — no mid-shift perspiration odour. Will be outfitting my whole surgical registrar cohort.

author: Dr. Alexander Chen
title: Australian hospital standard perfection
content: Clean, sharp, and modern. You look professional walking through private suites and comfortable running to code blues in ICU. The French Navy is rich and deep. Wash after wash at 60 degrees, the color holds like new.

author: Chloe Jenkins
title: Warm Taupe is gentle and the stretch is unreal
content: In paediatrics, kneeling on the floor to comfort scared kids is a constant requirement. The 4-way stretch knees and waistband make this effortless. Plus the kids love the softer aesthetic over harsh institutional green.
